cryptoquant.ai_master_brief: Across all 54 on-chain metrics, the tape leans defensive: 12 metrics sit at levels that historically preceded positive 21-day BTC returns versus 23 at historically negative levels, and the curated composite reads -0.27z. Valuation is the loudest signal — MVRV at the 10th percentile of 2010-present has been followed by +3.9% average 21-day returns (n=1169). Yearly extremes right now: Velocity near highs; BTC Depositing Addresses, Fund Flow Ratio, ETH Exchange Inflow, ETH Exchange Outflow, ETH Exchange Reserve near lows. The main caveat is that exchange netflows and dry-powder trends must confirm before this reads as an all-clear.

forecasts.ai: Base rates project BTC -1.8% over 1 month, -12.9% over 3 months, -29.2% over 6 months and +294.1% over 12 months (ensemble medians across 45 non-monotonic metrics at their current percentiles); ETH carries a 1.3x beta and altcoins 1.5x, amplifying both tails. These are historical conditional distributions, not promises — the ledger grades every one of them.
forecasts.method: Ensemble median of percentile-conditional forward returns across 45 non-monotonic metrics (2010-window where twins exist); ETH = 50/50 own-metric ensemble + BTC beta-link; alts = ltc/xrp/doge/ada/bch equal-weight index beta-link. PROVISIONAL, ledger-graded, not financial advice.

Weighted score → DORMANT/SETUP/IGNITION/CONFIRMED with REJECTED overlay; first CONFIRMED cross logs to the closed loop at sequel-table confidence.
